questions.text: Is there a family history of reading, spelling, or learning difficulties?
Did the child experience early speech delays or articulation difficulties?
Does the child struggle to learn or recall letter names and sounds?
Does the child have difficulty with nursery rhymes or identifying rhyming words?
Does the child frequently reverse letters (e.g. b/d, p/q) or words when reading/writing?
Does the child actively avoid reading tasks or express anxiety about reading aloud?
Does reading homework take significantly longer than expected for their age?
Has a teacher or tutor expressed concern about reading fluency or decoding skills?
